verdict.reasons: The image shows a single upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton (1 carton visible) with recognizable branding and the required watermark. However, it is separated from the installed plumbing. The thin white drip-tape lateral runs from the gauge connection, crosses the center of the image, and passes through the physical carton, violating the instruction to keep the commercial carton separate from installed plumbing. A pipe is visible passing through the carton, which is implausible. The gauge face is visible and shows a scale, whereas the instruction requires the gauge face to be angled away with no readable scale. These defects lower the quality score significantly.
